trans-unit.source: Bloom AI Image Tools creates images using AI models from Google and other providers. These models charge per image — you pay for them through {0}, a service that lets you pre-load credits and use them across providers. Credits start at $5 — enough for roughly 25–50 images — and are only spent when you generate images. There's no subscription.
trans-unit.target: Alat Gambar AI Bloom membuat gambar menggunakan model AI dari Google dan penyedia lain. Model-model ini menagih per gambar: Anda membayarnya melalui {0}, layanan yang memungkinkan Anda mengisi kredit di muka dan memakainya di berbagai penyedia. Kredit dimulai dari US$5, cukup untuk sekitar 25 sampai 50 gambar, dan hanya terpakai saat Anda membuat gambar. Tidak ada langganan.
trans-unit.note: First paragraph of the welcome dialog, explaining that making pictures costs money and is paid through a separate company. {0} is the word 'OpenRouter' in bold; it is a company name and stays in English. The prices are in US dollars.
